title: 5 Reasons Ninja's New Microwave Air Fryer Is the Only Gadget Your Kitchen Needs
angle: It's a $450 microwave, but hear us out. We break down why this 2-in-1 appliance isn't just another kitchen gadget, but a legitimate solution to decluttering your countertop and, finally, ending soggy leftovers forever.
rationale: It taps into a universal pain point (bad leftovers) and frames a new product within a larger trend, sparking a strong 'is it worth it?' debate for a mainstream audience.

source_articles.title: Ninja’s microwave air fryer could be the fix for soggy reheated pizza
